recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any future revival of $find-matches belongs in a new work-group decision or the Terminology Module Incubator IG, not as a FHIR-11820 reconciliation against current core.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU2 CodeSystem issue asking to rework $infers/$infer after a connectathon breakout: make $lookup clearly perform code decomposition, replace the old infer operation with an inverse composition-style operation, and start canonical external code-system definition work for SNOMED CT, LOINC, and RxNorm.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in svn revision 10029, represented by git commit 679dc9462a4671a7b3fc946ca79bbd330b37a172, which removed old $infer response material, added $compose request/response examples, updated the CodeSystem operation spreadsheet so $lookup was 'Concept Look Up & Decomposition', and added early SNOMED CT and LOINC CodeSystem definition material. No separate current RxNorm CodeSystem source file was found in core.
additional_context: FHIR-15956 later lowered the maturity and renamed $compose to $find-matches; FHIR-17563 then fixed remaining $compose references. Commit 40306e5cd9c1b1e3eb6f115de16a8da3aa13a351 removed $find-matches from active core CodeSystem operations for R6 normative-ballot preparation, and a 2026 Terminology Zulip thread confirms that $find-matches and $closure were removed from core because they were not mature enough for R6 normative status and were expected to move to a Terminology Module Incubator IG. Current core directs authoritative SNOMED CT, RxNorm, and LOINC usage information to THO/external terminology pages rather than restoring the old core canonical definition approach.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active source has no $infer or $compose operation, preserves decomposition language in CodeSystem $lookup, and lists only $lookup, $validate-code, and $subsumes in source/codesystem/list-CodeSystem-operations.xml. The leftover $find-matches text examples are not referenced by the active operation list or operation definitions, so editing them would not change current built specification semantics.

related_jiras.note: Published/Persuasive later issue changed CodeSystem/$compose maturity and renamed it to $find-matches.
Published/Persuasive later issue cleaned up residual $compose references after the rename to $find-matches.

R6 CodeSystem text technical correction mentioning external code systems was inspected as context only; its workflow status is Resolved - change required, so it was not decided in this default Applied/Published run.
